title: Moroccan Chebakia Bites with Mozzarella
description: A twist on traditional Moroccan pastries, these crispy bites are filled with melted mozzarella cheese and perfect as a snack or appetizer.

ingredients.name: Moroccan spice blend
ingredients.notes: ground cinnamon, ground ginger, ground cumin

instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, confectioners' sugar, and Moroccan spice blend.
Add the vibrant orange blossom water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into small balls and flatten each into a disk.
Place a piece of chebakia in the center of each disk and top with shredded mozzarella cheese.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Fry the pastries in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the pastries on paper towels and dust with confectioners' sugar.
Garnish with crispy chopped almonds and serve warm.
